## Card

`import { Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Padding is a `--card-spacing` variable on both axes, at 20px, so a full-bleed child can cancel it. The edge is a ring plus a shadow rather than a border. `ghost` drops the surface for a block that wants the card's rhythm but sits straight on the page.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'ghost'` | `'default'` |  |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `CardAction`

The header's top-right slot, for something the reader can do: a menu, an Edit link, a view toggle. Not a place to park a figure. A count where every other card puts its action reads as one; if a heading needs qualifying, put a hint next to the title.

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `CardContent`

`stack` turns on a vertical flex with a gap, for content that is several blocks rather than one. Off by default: `CardContent` stays a plain block, which is right for one child. `sm` / `md` / `lg` name the three gaps cards actually reach for, so the choice is made once, here.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stack` | `keyof typeof CONTENT_STACK_CLASS` |  |  |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `CardDescription`

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `CardFooter`

`bleed` runs the footer to the card's edges, for a footer that is one wide target ("View all orders") rather than content with actions in it. Three things happen together, which is why it is one prop: the card's bottom padding is cancelled, the horizontal padding goes (a Button inside gets the card's gutter back, so its label lines up with the title), and the bottom corners are rounded and clipped.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bleed` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `divided` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'muted'` | `'default'` |  |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `CardHeader`

The two explicit row tracks appear only when a `CardAction` is present. Upstream declares them unconditionally, so a title-only header carried an empty second track and its gutter. `auto-rows-min` already makes as many rows as there are children.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `divided` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `CardTitle`

A flex row, so a hint or a status badge sits on the title's baseline without the caller arranging it. `min-w-0` lets a long title truncate against its neighbour instead of pushing it out of the header.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `Snippet` |  | A leading glyph. Bare and muted at `size-4` unless `iconTone` is given. |
| `iconTone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` |  | Draws `icon` in an `IconChip` of this tone. Omit it for a quiet heading. `primary` when the headings are the page's structure, as on a long form. Never a status tone: a heading is not a status. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

Types: `CardVariant` (`'default' | 'ghost'`).

## CardGrid

`import { CardGrid, CardGridCell } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A responsive grid of bordered cells, with no opinion on what fills them. `MetricGrid` is this with a `MetricBar` in every cell; a caller whose cells are not a percent breakdown wants the grid on its own.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` | Columns at `md` and up. Below that it is always one: two cells side by side on a phone leave no room for real content. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `CardGridCell`

One cell. Bordered rather than filled or shadowed, deliberately lighter than `Card`: a wash or a ring on every cell of a dense grid competes with what the content needs to carry attention.

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

## CardList

`import { CardList } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A list of rows inside a card, separated by full-width rules. The rules run to the card's edges: inset, they read as stripes drawn on the content; full-bleed, they read as the card divided into rows.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compact` | `boolean` | `false` | Tighter rows, for rows of one line. The default `py-4` is sized for a leading chip and two lines. A prop rather than a class at the call site: a second arbitrary variant does not reliably win against this one. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

## Collapsible

`import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleTrigger } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Unstyled: the primitive holds open state and nothing else. `AsideCard` builds a real card on top of it; reach for `Collapsible` directly when the surface around it is not a card.

Also takes: bits-ui `Collapsible.Root` props.

## PageHeader

`import { PageHeader } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Which affordance a page carries, by what kind of page it is:

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  | Omit it when the trail carries the leaf and repeating it would add nothing. Without a title there is no `h1`, so the body owns the heading. |
| `description` | `string \| Snippet` |  |  |
| `breadcrumb` | `Snippet` |  | The trail of ancestors, above the title. Pass this or `backLink`, not both. |
| `backLink` | `Snippet` |  | A way back out, where the breadcrumb would be: the create-and-edit shape. |
| `eyebrow` | `string \| Snippet` |  | A short uppercase label naming the kind of page when the title cannot. |
| `titleAccessory` | `Snippet` |  | Inline with the title: a switcher, a status badge. |
| `truncateTitle` | `boolean` | `false` | One line, capped at `max-w-3xl`, with the whole title as a tooltip. For titles someone else wrote. |
| `actions` | `Snippet` |  | The right-hand action cluster. |
| `class` | `string` |  |  |

## SiteHeader

`import { SiteHeader, SiteHeaderSeparator } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

The bar above every page: a card floating on a blurred band that stays at the top while the page scrolls under it. Put the sidebar's trigger, a breadcrumb, `CommandTrigger` and the scheme or user menus inside, in a row; `SiteHeaderSeparator` divides groups.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contentClass` | `string` |  | Classes for the column the card sits in: its cap and padding. |

Also takes: every HTML attribute.

### `SiteHeaderSeparator`

`Separator`, vertical and 16px tall, with the bar's spacing either side.

Also takes: everything `Separator` takes except `orientation`.
